experiences.project: Security Engineering — AI for Security & Security for AI
experiences.problem: Strengthen the enterprise security posture across detection, offensive testing, and governance — and secure the AI systems doing the defending, beyond what reactive SOC alerting alone can catch.
experiences.approach: Converted from the cybersecurity internship into a full-time Security Engineer at the IS2 grade on 16 July 2026. Working across AI for Security and Security for AI — autonomous detection tooling and ML/agent supply-chain hardening — alongside VAPT engagements, SOC detection engineering across Microsoft Sentinel (KQL) and Splunk, and a shift-left DevSecOps focus.
experiences.impact: Delivering reusable, explainable detection engineering and maintaining an open-source security tooling suite; supporting GRC control audits (J-SOX, MICS) across IT general controls — access, change, and segregation-of-duties; and presenting security architecture and business value to executive leadership.

experiences.problem: Combat sophisticated, polymorphic email-borne exploits that evade traditional secure email gateways, requiring advanced threat intelligence and behavioral analysis.
experiences.approach: Completed intensive cybersecurity training — OSI/TCP-IP, DMZ design, VAPT (Burp Suite, Nmap, sqlmap, Nessus), OWASP Top 10 remediation (SQLi, XSS, Broken Access Control), SOC operations (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk SPL, Defender EDR/XDR), AWS Shared Responsibility Model, MFA/SSO (SAML/OAuth 2.0), DevSecOps shift-left, and OS hardening. Engineered a multi-agentic AI email-security system of 7 LangGraph-orchestrated agents to autonomously detect and neutralize threats in real time.
experiences.impact: The system reached ~96–97% threat-detection accuracy with a <0.8% miss rate and ~1.3% false positives, and cut SOC email triage from ~30 minutes to a few seconds via an explainable, SOC-ready decision pipeline — leading to conversion into a full-time Security Engineer (IS2) role at the end of the internship.

experiences.problem: Develop efficient X-ray normalization across multiple intensity levels using a single unified generator.
experiences.approach: Designed a novel Gated Multi-Domain CUT model with attention-based architecture and hybrid contrastive loss for high anatomical fidelity.
experiences.impact: Outperformed baselines (CycleGAN, StarGAN, CUT) achieving SSIM of 0.9858.

experiences.problem: Bridge the information gap between farmers and 50+ government welfare schemes through voice-driven AI.
experiences.approach: Built FastAPI backend with Prolog-based rule engine, end-to-end pipeline using Whisper, Azure Translator/TTS, and Gemma LLM for personalized voice interactions.
experiences.impact: Achieved <5s latency per query with 100% deterministic eligibility checks via hybrid Prolog+LLM architecture.

experiences.problem: Enable zero-shot analysis of medical body sounds (heart, respiratory, bowel) for healthcare diagnostics.
experiences.approach: Fine-tuned CLAP and CLIP on 20k+ medical audio samples from PhysioNet, BHIC, AudioSet, VGG-Sound. Built annotation + preprocessing pipeline with t-SNE visualization.
experiences.impact: Enabled zero-shot analysis across 10+ body sound classes with, high embedding quality.

experiences.problem: Improve Human Activity Recognition accuracy with graph-based spatiotemporal modeling.
experiences.approach: Developed HAR-GCNN model using Graph Convolutional Networks on PAMAP2 sensor dataset with robustness to 66% missing labels.
experiences.impact: Achieved 99.99% accuracy, outperforming CNN (99.75%) and LSTM ,(98.10%) across 3-25 activity classes.

experiences.problem: Contribute to ML research projects and knowledge sharing within the university.
experiences.approach: Participated in research initiatives, collaborated on ML projects, and contributed to team knowledge base.
experiences.impact: Built foundation in applied ML research and collaborative development.
